scope: Semantic ABI allocation proposal; not a complete wire specification or an SDK manifest

transport.error_result: existing status:i32 only; no appended diagnostic bytes
transport.serialization: No native structs, pointers, padding, implicit strings or unchecked trailing bytes
transport.cancellation: Core request cancellation for control requests; resource close for handles; explicit FILE lane cancellation for read-at
transport.compatibility: Existing service opcodes and payloads remain unchanged; every extension requires version and feature negotiation

identifiers.volume_id: opaque bytes[16]; persistent Host binding; labels and mount paths are not identity
identifiers.mount_epoch: u64; unique mount instance within this Host; not a persistent file capability
identifiers.grant_id: opaque bytes[16]; scoped to lineage-root and app-id; not transferable authority
identifiers.plan_id: opaque bytes[16]; bounded lifetime; bound to caller, target epoch and source revision
identifiers.operation_id: opaque bytes[16]; queryable independently of client transport
identifiers.idempotency_key: opaque bytes[16]; caller-scoped retry key, persisted with accepted operations
identifiers.handle: existing component-owned generation-checked u64; never persisted

rights_rules: Unknown bits are invalid; permissions are intersected with caller, grant and volume capabilities
File create needs create and write; truncate needs write; directory mutation needs the matching right
Rename needs remove on the source and create on the destination; replacement additionally needs destination remove
A read-only directory picker request maps to read plus enumerate; returned rights are explicit
Closing a directory does not revoke independently held children; revoking its grant invalidates all children
Managed .pxa-* aliases and volume-relative /PXA/system, /PXA/app, /PXA/data and /PXA/.pxa-control remain excluded according to native filesystem name equivalence; /PXA/media may be granted

opcodes.name: open-root
opcodes.rule: kind private=1/cache=2/temporary=3/grant=4/app-media=5; permission and grant_id zero except kind=4; kind=4 resolves exact declared user-directory authority; kind=5 requires app-media-root and Host identity/placement binding without picker

opcodes.name: request-access
opcodes.rule: flags bit0=persistent; unknown flags invalid; purpose <=256 bytes; all-zero grant_id for session-only access; exact Permission authority plus trusted Host picker required

opcodes.name: open-at
opcodes.rule: Existing FS open flags; directory handle if directory requested, FILE otherwise; features and size describe the opened object

opcodes.name: rename-at
opcodes.rule: Same volume and compatible authority; destination absent; cross-volume unsupported

opcodes.name: replace-at
opcodes.rule: Same volume and compatible authority; atomic closed-regular-file replacement only; failure preserves old destination; unsupported without backend guarantee

opcodes.name: query-root
opcodes.rule: Caller-visible root only; quota-scoped free space where applicable

opcodes.name: sync
opcodes.rule: Async control operation; flush does not invent stronger media durability

opcodes.name: read-directory-page
opcodes.rule: Bounded result <=4076 bytes including status; live iterator, no snapshot promise; no silent name truncation

opcodes.name: watch-roots
opcodes.rule: One bounded component-visible subscription; closing LEASE ends it

events.name: roots-changed
events.delivery: coalescible per component and watch lease; requery visible roots

services.name: assets

opcodes.name: open-blob
opcodes.rule: Read-only declared package blob; retain package generation until final FILE and in-flight references close; report random-read capability explicitly

services.verification_policy: Verify during installation; trust installed content at runtime; no new read-time, launch-time or remount hash scan

services.name: store-installer
services.authorization: Trusted system management components only; never grants arbitrary applications global volume or installer access

opcodes.name: execute-operation
opcodes.rule: Accepted is not committed; repeat of same authorized plan and key returns same operation; never duplicates activation

opcodes.name: cancel-operation
opcodes.rule: Before commit cancel candidate; after commit return committed state, do not report rolled-back install

opcodes.name: set-default-volume
opcodes.rule: Preference only; cannot relocate installed content or silently fall back while chosen volume is offline

events.name: operation-changed
events.delivery: coalescible hint; query durable operation state

operations.name: read-at
operations.return: actual data byte count, zero at or beyond EOF, or existing negative PXA status
operations.rule: Implemented synchronous profile: requested is 1..4096, buffer size exactly 24+requested, reserved zero, offset+requested cannot overflow; cookie is strictly increasing and nonzero per FILE; completion/error retires it; reused/retired returns cancelled; no cursor mutation or retained Guest pointer

operations.name: cancel-read-at
operations.return: 0 on idempotent cancellation or existing negative PXA status
operations.rule: Implemented synchronous profile: exact 8-byte nonzero cookie; idempotently retire all cookies through this value; no background operation to interrupt

file_io_extension.waiting: Future asynchronous lane only: Existing Core wait-resource READ readiness and PXA_IO_POLL; tolerate spurious wakeups; file close cancels lane
file_io_extension.retry_safety: Validate destination before consuming a completed result; invalid destination cannot publish partial ownership or write outside Guest memory

implemented_profile.cookie: strictly increasing per FILE; completed calls retire; cancelled/reused returns cancelled
implemented_profile.cancel: idempotently retire cookies through supplied nonzero value
implemented_profile.memory: caller header+data borrowed only for current call; no retained pointer, worker, pending lane or WOULD_BLOCK

file_io_extension.asynchronous_lane_status: proposal only; requires additional opt-in capability before enabling the pending/readiness rules

asynchronous_lane_proposal.status: not implemented; requires an additional opt-in capability
asynchronous_lane_proposal.read_at: same tuple retrieves pending result; at most one lane per FILE; different in-flight tuple is busy; no retained Guest pointer
asynchronous_lane_proposal.cancel: invalidate matching lane; discard late completion without delivery
asynchronous_lane_proposal.readiness: Core wait-resource READ and PXA_IO_POLL; tolerate spurious wakeups; close cancels lane

permission_integration.rule: Resolve supplied Permission handle against an exact signed declaration, intersect its rights with grant and volume; no wildcard scope matching; propagate authority to descendants and requests
permission_integration.revocation: Existing Permission authority revocation closes all bound resources; individual GrantId revocation additionally invalidates only that grant subtree
permission_integration.sdk_lifetime: Keep permission lease alive through all dependent root and file references; closing root alone must not revoke independently owned children

semantic_records_to_finalize_in_wire_spe.utf8-u16: byte_length:u16 followed by exactly that many UTF-8 bytes; per-field limits checked; no NUL
semantic_records_to_finalize_in_wire_spe.RootInfo: volume_id, mount_epoch, current_state, naming_semantics, granted_rights, root_capabilities, max_path_bytes, max_segment_bytes, max_read_at_bytes, quota_or_space_info with known flags
semantic_records_to_finalize_in_wire_spe.DirectoryPage: iterator state, explicit EOF, bounded count and variable-length name/kind/size entries; no hidden overflow
semantic_records_to_finalize_in_wire_spe.PageRequest: snapshot revision plus opaque continuation cursor and result budget; initial cursor zero; stale revisions require rescan; no unbounded lists
semantic_records_to_finalize_in_wire_spe.VolumeInfo: volume_id, mount_epoch, state, identity_strength, display_name, filesystem, removable, hotplug, read_only, capabilities, install_backend_grade, space_known_flags, total/free/reserved u64, allocation_unit, file_size_limit
semantic_records_to_finalize_in_wire_spe.OperationIntent: action install/whole-app-move/package-move/data-move, app identity, expected source placement revision, layout_version, placement_policy, package/data/app-media target volumes and epochs, selected SystemRoot, source metadata and validated-or-estimated sizing
semantic_records_to_finalize_in_wire_spe.OperationPlan: plan_id, deadline, target binding, source revision, reservations on each volume and control store, sizing confidence, negotiated upload and expansion limits, user-visible consequences
semantic_records_to_finalize_in_wire_spe.InstallSource: authorized Store ticket or existing installed source; PXADB candidate/upload lease is Host-only; never Guest-selected native path
semantic_records_to_finalize_in_wire_spe.OperationState: operation_id, revision, stage, bytes_done/total with known flags, committed flag, result status, resulting location revision; bounded durable retention
semantic_records_to_finalize_in_wire_spe.InstalledLocation: identity, version, location_revision, layout_version, placement_policy, SystemId, StoreId, package volume/release, data volume/DataId, backend kinds, online state; publisher identity independent of location

status_mapping.closed_generation_mismatch_or_wrong_comp: not-found under existing Core handle lookup; malformed encoding remains invalid-argument

implementation_gates: Finalize referenced record encodings, feature manifests and golden wire vectors before generating SDK headers
Validate permission manifest integration, trusted picker and revocation on every returned descendant handle
Keep original FS byte-exact private semantics and old installer slot recovery unchanged
Qualify backend sync and crash recovery before advertising removable volume installation
Keep selected SystemRoot placement metadata authoritative, whether on internal storage or SD; never activate a removable generation by directory scan alone
Measure device RAM, read latency, frame times and audio underruns; storage space is not execution memory

implementation_status.gamekit: one registered FAT volume, trusted picker, persistent grants; hardware SD read test passed
implementation_status.gamekit_fixed_media: Hardware first launch and reboot PASS with signed pxa-fixed-files and no file permission declaration or directory picker

control_store.location: Selected SystemRoot on a qualified internal or SD volume
control_store.recovery: Compiled firmware UI must work without external fonts or control data
control_store.activation: Control-store commit only; never volume directory scan
control_store.removal: Stop dependent system instances and use firmware recovery
